why: The world's time naming both bodies: the moon just risen and the sun setting. The moon stands exactly opposite the sun, so two bodies are either one hour written twice or two hours at once — here two (12959 and 12782 ticks), and nothing could say which the delve is played at. `DW0931` refuses it at validation with the remedy: name one body. It declares no unit: `CelestialTime.sun` and `CelestialTime.moon` are both bound by the primary.
